card.name: Mixed words in general prose
card.fires_on: No shared pattern. It fires on scattered words such as 'of', 'the', 'facts', 'is' and word pieces in general web prose, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Words like 'of' or 'the' inside descriptive encyclopedic sentences about places or people.
modes.example: to spend some summer weeks at Brucebo on the island<< of>> Gotland, became reality.

modes.label: The noun facts
modes.description: The word 'facts' after 'chemical' or 'the' in older scientific prose.
modes.example: to the chemical<< facts>> already well ascertained, we ded
